# MP0026

Injects a module into a module constructor; declare DependsOn and use context.GetModule or context.GetModuleIfRegistered.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Category | Usage |
| Default severity | Warning |
| Availability | Public analyzer package |

## Configure severity

```ini title=".editorconfig"
dotnet_diagnostic.MP0026.severity = warning
```

Use `none` to disable the rule, or `silent`, `suggestion`, `warning`, or `error` to change its severity.

## Suppress a specific occurrence

```csharp
#pragma warning disable MP0026
// Code that intentionally violates MP0026.
#pragma warning restore MP0026
```
